2115995239861391639.en_summary: $AMZN + $GOOGL reported and their stocks sold off hard. Neither is slowing the AI build. Alphabet maintained $195–205B 2026 capex guide, spending will rise significantly in 2027. Cloud revenue more than doubled. Amazon held ~$220B 2026 capex, Jassy said will spend meaningfully more next year. AWS grew 39% with 40%+ growth guided for 2027 and 2028. Market reacting to Search miss and sluggish ecommerce, and cash burn, not AI slowdown. The gap is the opportunity.
2115995239861391639.zh_summary: $AMZN + $GOOGL 公佈業績後股價大幅下跌。兩者均未放緩 AI 建設。Alphabet 維持 1950-2050 億美元 2026 年資本支出指引，並表示 2027 年支出將顯著增加。雲端收入增長超過一倍。Amazon 維持約 2200 億美元 2026 年資本支出，Jassy 表示明年將有意義地增加支出。AWS 增長 39%，並指引 2027 及 2028 年增長超過 40%。市場正反應 Google 搜尋未達標及 Amazon 電子商務疲軟，以及現金消耗，而非 AI 基礎設施需求放緩。這個差距就是機會。
